theme: 教材字彙・高分 850–900 第 63 群

items.pos: n. 消息；諾言 | v. 用詞
items.colloc: keep one's word 信守承諾 | spread the word 廣為宣傳
items.distinct: promise 承諾（重行為）| remark 評論
ex: Please keep your word regarding the deadline.
關於截止日期請信守承諾。
I sent word to the manager about the delay.
我已通知經理關於延誤的消息。
The executive carefully worded the official statement.
主管仔細斟酌了官方聲明的措辭。

items.pos: v. 包裝；完成 | n. 包裝紙
items.colloc: wrap up 結束工作 | gift wrap 禮品包裝
items.distinct: pack 打包（裝箱）| cover 覆蓋
ex: Let's wrap up this project before the weekend.
我們在週末前結束這個專案吧。
The staff helped wrap the fragile items carefully.
員工協助小心包裝易碎物品。
We need to wrap up the meeting in five minutes.
我們需要在五分鐘內結束會議。

items.pos: n. 高峰 | adj. 高峰的
items.colloc: peak season 旺季 | reach a peak 達到頂峰
items.distinct: summit 山頂（物理）| climax 高潮（劇情）
ex: Sales reached their peak during the holiday season.
銷售額在假期期間達到高峰。
The hotel charges higher rates during peak season.
飯店在旺季時收取較高費用。
Productivity hit a new peak last quarter.
生產力在上季度創下新高。

items.pos: prep. 除了……之外 | v. 反對
items.colloc: except for 除……之外 | with the exception of 例外
items.distinct: besides 除了（包含在內）| apart from 除了
ex: Everyone attended the seminar except the manager.
除了經理之外大家都參加了研討會。
The office is open daily except on Sundays.
辦公室除了週日外每天開放。
All departments met the target except marketing.
除了行銷部外所有部門都達標了。

items.pos: n. 裂縫；嘗試 | v. 破裂；破解
items.colloc: crack the code 破解密碼 | crack a smile 露出微笑
items.distinct: fracture 骨折（醫學）| split 分裂
ex: The screen has a small crack near the edge.
螢幕邊緣有一道小裂縫。
Our team finally managed to crack the market.
我們的團隊終於成功打入市場。
The technician tried to crack the security system.
技術人員嘗試破解安全系統。

items.pos: n. 被告 | adj. 被指控的
items.colloc: accused of 指控…… | the accused 被告人
items.distinct: defendant 被告（法律程序）| suspect 嫌疑犯
ex: The accused denied all charges during the trial.
被告在審判中否認了所有指控。
He was accused of mishandling company funds.
他被指控不當處理公司資金。
The accused party refused to make any comments.
被告方拒絕發表任何評論。

items.colloc: awfully sorry 非常抱歉 | awfully busy 非常忙碌
items.distinct: very 非常（中性）| terrible 可怕的
ex: I am awfully sorry for the late response.
對於遲回覆我感到非常抱歉。
The CEO looked awfully tired after the trip.
執行長出差後看起來非常疲憊。
It was awfully kind of you to help us.
你真是太好心了願意幫助我們。

items.colloc: booking reference 預訂編號 | make a booking 預約
items.distinct: reservation 訂位（餐廳、飯店）| appointment 預約（醫生、諮詢）
ex: Please confirm your booking before arriving here.
抵達此處前請先確認您的預訂。
The online booking system is currently down.
線上預訂系統目前無法運作。
We need to make a booking for ten people.
我們需要預訂十個人的位置。

items.colloc: cheerful atmosphere 愉快的氣氛 | in a cheerful mood 心情愉悅
items.distinct: happy 快樂的 | optimistic 樂觀的
ex: The new office has a cheerful and bright design.
新辦公室設計得既愉快又明亮。
She always maintains a cheerful attitude at work.
她在工作中總是保持愉快的態度。
The team received cheerful news regarding the merger.
團隊收到了關於合併的愉快消息。

items.colloc: weekly column 每週專欄 | opinion column 意見專欄
items.distinct: article 文章 | paragraph 段落
ex: Please fill in the data in the last column.
請填寫最後一欄的數據。
He writes a business column for the newspaper.
他為該報紙撰寫商業專欄。
The table contains four columns and five rows.
該表格包含四欄五列。

items.zh: 有說服力的；令人信服的
items.colloc: convincing argument 有力的論點 | convincing evidence 有力證據
items.distinct: persuasive 具勸說力的 | impressive 令人印象深刻的
ex: The candidate gave a very convincing presentation.
該候選人做了非常有說服力的簡報。
She provided convincing evidence to support the claim.
她提供了有說服力的證據來支持該主張。
Your reasoning is quite convincing to the board.
你的推論對董事會來說相當有說服力。

items.colloc: city council 市議會 | advisory council 諮詢委員會
items.distinct: committee 小組（處理特定事務）| board 董事會
ex: The city council approved the new construction plan.
市議會批准了新的建設方案。
The advisory council will meet later this afternoon.
諮詢委員會將於今天下午稍後開會。
She represents her department on the safety council.
她代表部門參加安全委員會。

items.colloc: feel depressed 感到沮喪 | depressed market 蕭條市場
items.distinct: sad 難過的 | discouraged 灰心的
ex: The local economy remained depressed for several years.
當地經濟維持蕭條了好幾年。
Employees felt depressed due to the pay cuts.
員工因為減薪而感到沮喪。
High unemployment led to a depressed retail sector.
高失業率導致零售業蕭條。

items.pos: n. 草稿 | v. 起草
items.colloc: first draft 初稿 | draft a contract 起草合約
items.distinct: sketch 草圖 | outline 大綱
ex: Could you help me draft the new policy?
你可以幫我起草新政策嗎？
I have finished the first draft of the report.
我已經完成了報告的初稿。
Please review the draft before the final version.
請在定稿前審閱這份草案。

items.colloc: make a fortune 發大財 | good fortune 好運
items.distinct: wealth 財富（總體）| luck 運氣（隨機）
ex: He made a fortune in the real estate market.
他在房地產市場發了一筆財。
It was a matter of good fortune to be selected.
能夠被選中純屬運氣好。
The company spent a fortune on the renovation.
公司在翻修上花了一大筆錢。

items.colloc: generous donation 慷慨捐贈 | generous offer 優渥條件
items.distinct: kind 親切的 | charitable 慈善的
ex: The company offers a generous benefits package.
公司提供優渥的福利方案。
We appreciate your generous support for our event.
我們感謝您對活動的慷慨支持。
She made a generous donation to the local hospital.
她對當地醫院進行了慷慨的捐贈。

items.zh: 綠色的；環保的；無經驗的
items.colloc: green energy 綠色能源 | green building 環保建築
items.distinct: eco-friendly 環保的 | environmental 環境的
ex: Our firm focuses on green technology solutions.
我們公司專注於綠色技術解決方案。
More companies are adopting green building practices.
越來越多公司採用環保建築實務。
They aim to make the supply chain more green.
他們的目標是讓供應鏈更環保。

items.colloc: measuring instrument 測量儀器 | musical instrument 樂器
items.distinct: tool 工具（手動）| device 裝置（小型設備）
ex: The technician calibrated the instrument carefully.
技術員仔細校準了測量儀器。
Data collection is an important instrument for research.
資料收集是研究的重要工具。
We need to purchase a new testing instrument.
我們需要採購一台新的測試儀器。

items.colloc: justly rewarded 得到應得的回報 | justly criticized 被公正地批評
items.distinct: fairly 公平地 | rightly 正當地
ex: The manager was justly rewarded for his hard work.
經理因其辛勤工作而得到應得的回報。
The decision was justly criticized by the board.
該決定受到了董事會公正的批評。
All employees should be treated justly and equally.
所有員工都應被公正平等地對待。

items.colloc: mistakenly believed 錯誤地認為 | mistakenly sent 誤寄
items.distinct: wrongly 錯誤地（反對）| incorrectly 不正確地
ex: I mistakenly sent the email to the wrong person.
我錯誤地將郵件寄給了錯的人。
They mistakenly believed the deal was already closed.
他們錯誤地認為交易已經結束。
The package was mistakenly delivered to our office.
包裹被錯誤地送到我們辦公室。
